GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading for comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.

2. When practising Listening for gist, Imitative speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist, Imitative speaking.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist, Imitative speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist, Imitative speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist, Imitative speaking.

3. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Buch
   C. Haus
   D. Wasser

4. When practising Reading Aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud.

5. When practising Listening for gist, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for gist.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for gist.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for gist.

6. When practising Guided writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided writing.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Guided writing.

7. When practising Phonological awareness, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological awareness.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological awareness.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological awareness.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological awareness.

8. When practising Reading aloud, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading aloud.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading aloud.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading aloud.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading aloud.

9. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Good night
   B. Please
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Thank you

10. When practising Guided reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Guided reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Guided reading.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Guided reading.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading aloud and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Guided reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for gist, Imitative speaking.

9. C — Good day / hello

10. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided reading.
